This page collects teaching materials, workshop handouts, and instructional resources developed for training junior researchers and clinical staff in biostatistics and data science.

---

## Weekly Huddle Statistics Workshops

**Mount Sinai Hospital — Geriatrics & Palliative Care**

I run weekly statistics workshops ("huddles") for the research team at Mount Sinai, covering practical applied biostatistics using Stata. Topics are driven by real analytical challenges encountered in our research projects.

📂 [View All Workshop Materials on GitHub](https://github.com/honoluluhan717/huddle-workshops){target="_blank"}
